verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships a first-party passkey() plugin, shown in its own config example, and its homepage lists "Passkeys, magic links" among built-in auth methods. A hands-on community report confirms passkeys took about 7 lines of server code with little client change. Magic links appear only as a homepage mention, and the email/SMS OTP in the evidence belongs to the 2FA plugin (a second factor), not a primary passwordless sign-in. missing for 10: dedicated passkey/WebAuthn plugin documentation, magic-link plugin docs or hands-on corroboration, evidence of email OTP as a primary sign-in method.
